caption: A person uses a pair of pliers to open a stubborn metal bottle, bending the cap slightly in the process.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A person uses a pair of pliers to open a stubborn metal bottle, bending the cap slightly in the process. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The person must hold the pliers firmly with both hands to apply controlled pressure.
The pliers must be positioned to grip the edge of the metal bottle cap securely.
The cap must be visibly bent inward slightly as the pliers apply force.
The bottle must remain stable and upright throughout the action.
